name: io.github.zyvorai/kairon
title: Kairon
description: Inspect Kairon VMs, network policy and VM-edge flows from an agent. Read-only by default.

environmentVariables.name: KAIRON_KUBE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Kubernetes API server URL, e.g. https://k8s.example:6443. The server only offers read tools unless --allow-write is appended to the container arguments; the image never sets it.

environmentVariables.name: KAIRON_KUBE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for the Kubernetes API. Bind it to a Role with only the verbs the agent needs (get/list on machines for read-only use).

environmentVariables.name: KAIRON_KUBE_CA
environmentVariables.description: Path, inside the container, of the CA bundle for the Kubernetes API (mount it). Leave unset to use system roots.

environmentVariables.name: KAIRON_KUBE_INSECURE
environmentVariables.description: Set to "true" to skip TLS verification of the Kubernetes API. Lab use only.

environmentVariables.name: KAIRON_UI_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of kairon-ui; needed by the machine_network tool (network flows, drops, capture sessions).

environmentVariables.name: KAIRON_UI_CA
environmentVariables.description: Path, inside the container, of the CA certificate for a self-signed kairon-ui (mount it).

environmentVariables.name: KAIRON_UI_INSECURE
environmentVariables.description: Set to "true" to skip TLS verification of kairon-ui. Lab use only.

environmentVariables.name: KAIRON_LLM_URL
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint for the optional ask tool and the summary in diagnose.

environmentVariables.name: KAIRON_MCP_TENANT
environmentVariables.description: Scope the claim tools, diagnose and ask to this tenant.
